description: This PHP class extends tlFilterPanel to manage filters and settings for test case trees by requirement in the TestLink project. It handles session management, user input, filter initialization, and tree building logic for different modes and features within the test management interface.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterByRequirementControl
classes.description: A class for managing test case filters by requirement in the TestLink interface, including session handling, filter initialization, and tree building.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter control, loads configuration, manages session data, and sets up filter and tree options based on mode.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unsets manager objects.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Loads configuration settings specific to requirements filtering from the global config.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Reads user input from request parameters and prepares filter parameters.

methods.name: init_settings
methods.description: Initializes filter and mode settings based on configuration and mode.

methods.name: init_filters
methods.description: Initializes all filters based on configuration and mode, activating only those enabled.

methods.name: get_active_filters
methods.description: Returns current active filter selections, as object or array depending on mode.

methods.name: set_testcases_to_show
methods.description: Sets the number of test cases to display and updates session data.

methods.name: save_session_data
methods.description: Stores current filter state in session, associated with form token.

methods.name: delete_old_session_data
methods.description: Removes outdated session filter data based on timestamp.

methods.name: delete_own_session_data
methods.description: Removes session data related to this filter control's form token.

methods.name: generate_form_token
methods.description: Creates a unique integer token for session identification of filter state.

methods.name: get_argument_string
methods.description: Builds URL query string with current filter and session token parameters.

methods.name: build_tree_menu
methods.description: Generates the test case requirement tree structure for the GUI, with filtering options.

methods.name: init_setting_refresh_tree_on_action
methods.description: Initializes the setting for automatic tree refresh on user actions.

methods.name: init_setting_get_parent_child_relation
methods.description: Initializes the setting for parent-child relation display in the tree.

methods.name: init_setting_testplan
methods.description: Loads and sets the current test plan, managing session and filtering options.

methods.name: init_setting_testsgroupby
methods.description: Initializes the grouping mode for test suites.

methods.name: init_filter_tc_id
methods.description: Initializes the filter for test case ID.

methods.name: init_filter_testcase_name
methods.description: Initializes the filter for test case name.

methods.name: init_filter_toplevel_testsuite
methods.description: Initializes the filter for top-level test suites.

methods.name: init_filter_keywords
methods.description: Initializes keyword-based filters for test cases.

methods.name: init_filter_active_inactive
methods.description: Initializes filter for active/inactive test cases.

methods.name: init_filter_importance
methods.description: Initializes importance level filter for test cases.

methods.name: init_filter_priority
methods.description: Initializes priority filter for test cases.

methods.name: init_filter_execution_type
methods.description: Initializes execution type filter for test cases.

methods.name: init_filter_assigned_user
methods.description: Initializes assigned user filter for test cases.

methods.name: init_filter_result
methods.description: Initializes result-based filters for test cases.

methods.name: init_filter_bugs
methods.description: Initializes bug-related filters.

methods.name: init_filter_workflow_status
methods.description: Initializes workflow status filter for test cases.

methods.name: initTreeOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the test case requirement tree.

methods.name: init_advanced_filter_mode
methods.description: Enables advanced filtering mode based on current mode.

methods.name: init_filter_doc_id
methods.description: Initializes filter for document ID.

methods.name: init_filter_title
methods.description: Initializes filter for test case title.

methods.name: init_filter_status
methods.description: Initializes filter for test case status.

methods.name: init_filter_type
methods.description: Initializes filter for test case type.

methods.name: init_filter_spec_type
methods.description: Initializes filter for specification type.

methods.name: init_filter_coverage
methods.description: Initializes coverage filter if enabled.

methods.name: init_filter_relation
methods.description: Initializes requirement relation filter.

methods.name: getCustomFields
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields linked to the test project for filtering.
